summary.intent: Orchestrate parallel worker agents to land several Caliper PRs (#347, #343, #367/#348/#349, #353), including scaling back an over-engineered #347 fix and resolving a merge conflict on #353 requested by the user.
summary.outcome: #347 was redirected to a simpler design (module-level-only interface merging) and a worker was dispatched to resolve the provider.ts conflict on #353; neither result was confirmed yet, and other workers were still running.

repo: Entire trail change URLs map to PRs (trail 206 change 150 is #353, branch fix/addon-and-plugin-failures).
A lint gate enforces a 300-line limit on files such as vite-plugin/src/index.ts, likely the reason napiOptions was moved to options.ts.
PR #367 owns the forged `as unknown as CsfFile` objects in the Storybook provider, so other PRs should leave them alone.
CI includes Entire Gates, and review findings should only be counted after those gates finish.
Enums and classes are still keyed by bare name in the extractor; function-local interfaces sharing a name with another declaration are not isolated (to be documented in docs/edge-cases.md).
The resolver already has a scope model, so the extractor should not build a second one.

code.finding: The only file conflicting when merging main (81 commits ahead) into PR #353; the resolution must keep main's fixes plus the PR's behaviours (warn once on failed start, no cached rejection, start-vs-refresh wording, validated options).

workflow: Interim 'waiting on background work' agent notifications carry no new info; check GitHub state directly instead.
A verification check that compares only property-name sets cannot catch displayed-type leaks; tests should assert the rendered prop type.
By round 5 of review, an instruction like 'make it structural' can push a worker into a bigger design than the finding needed; scale back and preserve work on a wip branch.
Preserve in-progress work on a wip branch and use new commits rather than force-pushing when reverting a design.
Have conflict-resolution workers re-read merged test files for tests that pass for the wrong reason, and verify with lint, unit and integration tests, and a clean-room run in a pristine worktree.

friction: Rework for #347 introduced regressions: function-local interface refs were rewritten to `Name@<offset>` and leaked into output (e.g. `item: Item@57`), and type-parameter shadowing broke (`Props<string>` rendered as `number`).
#353 was 81 commits behind main, producing a conflict in provider.ts.
Worker agents repeatedly sent interim notifications while waiting on CI, adding noise.
open_items: Confirm the #347 worker's scale-back (wip/interface-scope-structural branch, removal of scoped-key machinery and oracle script, new tests, docs/edge-cases.md update).
Confirm the #353 provider.ts conflict resolution and its checks; verify that the napiOptions move to options.ts exists to meet the 300-line lint limit before dismissing the low finding.
Wait for #347's last four checks and Entire Gates.
Wait for the #367/#348/#349 worker to finish.
#367 still owns cleanup of the forged `as unknown as CsfFile` objects.
